q1.a: You get a private link. Send it over WhatsApp or anywhere — they tap it and the animated experience plays right in their browser. Nothing to install.

q2.q: How does payment work for premium templates?
q2.a: We show you an InstaPay number. You transfer the amount, upload a screenshot and reference, and once our team confirms it your link unlocks.

q3.a: Yes. Templates come in Arabic (right-to-left, with Arabic display fonts) and in English — pick the language of the card when you choose its design.

q4.a: Yes. Your cards live in your dashboard, and changes you save show up on the same link — no need to send a new one.

q5.q: How do guests RSVP to a wedding invitation?
q5.a: The invitation has an RSVP button that opens WhatsApp with a reply already written, addressed to the number you set. Replies land in your chats — there's no separate form to check.

q6.q: Can I see a template before paying?
q6.a: Yes. Every template in the gallery is a live preview of the real design, and you can build and preview your whole card before you pay for a premium one.
